description: Create the minimal server-safe Next.js App Router runtime and PULSE visual foundation without implementing any main product feature.
steps: In /Users/shivain/Desktop/chenyun project, create package.json/package-lock.json and Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, Vitest, RTL, and Playwright configuration with the exact scripts in implementation-plan.md; preserve the deleted AskMongo baseline.
